findings.title: OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint passes unsupported keyword argument to Endpoint.paginate and uses non-datetime paginator on datetime field
findings.body: `OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint.get()` calls `self.paginate(..., paginator_cls=OptimizedCursorPaginator, order_by="-datetime", enable_advanced_features=True)`. First, `Endpoint.paginate()` in Sentry does not accept `enable_advanced_features` unless it forwards `**kwargs` to `paginator_cls` (and even if it does, `OptimizedCursorPaginator` is a `Paginator`-style class rather than `DateTimePaginator`). In `OptimizedCursorPaginator`, `get_item_key` calls `math.floor(getattr(item, self.key))` on `AuditLogEntry.datetime` (a `datetime` object), which raises `TypeError: must be real number, not datetime.datetime`, and `value_from_cursor` returns the raw numeric cursor value instead of converting it to a `datetime` for the SQL comparison on the `datetime` column. Finally, these audit log / paginator changes are completely unrelated to the PR's stated purpose (spans buffer insertion).

findings.title: Allowing negative offsets in BasePaginator and OptimizedCursorPaginator causes ValueError on Django QuerySet slicing
findings.body: In `BasePaginator.get_result` (line 182) and `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result` (lines 880-886), negative `cursor.offset` values are passed directly into `queryset[start_offset:stop]` when `cursor.is_prev` is true or `enable_advanced_features` is enabled. Django's `QuerySet.__getitem__` explicitly forbids negative slice indices and raises `ValueError: Negative indexing is not supported.` Furthermore, if `start_offset` is negative and `stop` (`start_offset + limit + extra`) is positive, a client supplying a crafted cursor string like `0:-10:1` will trigger an unhandled 500 error (`ValueError`) on any endpoint using `BasePaginator` or `OptimizedCursorPaginator`.
